Priya: Quick design check: in the new alert suppression UI the mock uses the label 'Quiet period (snooze alerts)'. Ops folks have complained about 'snooze' before. I want wording that's explicit and scannable in lists. Thoughts?
Jon: Avoid 'snooze' here. It's too consumer-y. 'Silence' is ok but 'Suppress notifications' or 'Silence alerts' are clearer for SREs.
Sophie: +1 to 'Suppress notifications'. Also we need to be explicit about timezones. The mock shows 'In 15m' and that trips people up. Show local time + a small UTC badge.
Rae: Accessibility: when suppression toggles we should announce status via aria-live: e.g., 'Alerts suppressed until 14:00 PDT'. Make that message consistent with the displayed text.
Priya: Good point. For list views what about a compact pill: [icon] Suppress notifications — ends 2:00 PM PDT? Icon alone fails for colorblind. Include short text and ensure contrast.
Jon: For keyboard users, hitting Enter on the pill should open an inline editor panel (not a full modal on desktop). Inline editor keeps context for quick edits. Panel should have role="dialog" and set focus to the end-time input.
Sophie: Inline editor header copy should be sentence case: 'Suppress notifications'. Keep copy identical across pill hover, editor, and toasts.
Rae: Preview overlay needs to surface which channels are silenced. Current mock only lists 'Slack'. Add a small table: Email / Slack / PagerDuty with check icons. Also show 'Created by' and timestamp on hover.
Priya: UX copy for the time selector: current label 'Until' vs 'Ends'. I prefer 'Ends' (shorter). Options: 15m, 1h, 4h, Custom. Default to 1h for ad-hoc silences.
Jon: Mobile note: inline panel may be cramped. On small screens fallback to a full-screen modal. Also provide a confirmation before removing suppression: toast should read 'Notifications will resume immediately' instead of vague 'Removed'.
Sophie: Tiny a11y nit: the icon inside the pill should have an aria-hidden true and we must include a visually-hidden text next to it for screenreaders. Also ensure the UTC badge is read: '10:00 PM UTC'.
Rae: Implementation detail from backend: API returns suppression as `{"enabled":true,"ends_at":"2026-07-01T14:00:00-07:00","creator":"priya"}`. Frontend should format into local + UTC strings.
Priya: QA checklist I'm planning to add to the PR: keyboard focus order, role/dialog focus trap, aria-live announcements for enable/disable, color contrast >=4.5, channel matrix populated, toast copy update.
Jon: One more microcopy ask: in the inline editor the save button should say 'Save suppression' not just 'Save' to reduce ambiguity.
Sophie: Agree. And add a small 'Remember my choice' toggle for power users who want to persist their default duration.
figma-bot: Figma: frames updated for suppression flows. Link: https://figma.com/file/updated-suppression-frames
Priya: I'll iterate the figma mocks with the new copy and post the link here when ready. Thanks for the rapid feedback :thumbsup:
